name: AcceptCreativeHandoff
story: As a member, I want to hand a selected mockup to Workshop with constraints, so that design work starts from a pinned reference.

mcp.description: Attach a selected mockup as a design request without modifying CAD.

name: AssemblyChanges
story: As an authorized caller, I want to apply assembly changes using explicit actions, so that each change has a durable receipt and explicit next steps.

key.description: Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.

name: AttachCreativeResult
story: As a member, I want to link a result candidate to the original mockup request, so that presentations and marketing can reuse its evidence.

mcp.description: Link a committed result candidate back to its design request.

name: ClaimWorkshopBuild
story: As a workspace runner, I want to claim a queued build at its observed revision, so that concurrent runners cannot execute the same request.

name: ConceptChanges
story: As an authorized caller, I want to apply concept changes using explicit actions, so that each change has a durable receipt and explicit next steps.

key.description: Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.
Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.

name: CreateWorkshopProject
story: As a member, I want to start a project from a starter example on the Workshop page or through an agent, named for the product revision it builds, so that I can refine a working model instead of a blank one.

mcp.description: Create a Workshop project for a product or PCB package and return its ID and revision.

name: DeleteWorkshopProject
story: As a member, I want to delete a project at the revision I saw, so that I never remove what someone else just changed.

name: DeleteWorkshopUnit
story: As a member, I want to remove a unit I recorded by mistake or scrapped at the revision I saw, so that the inventory counts only units that exist.

name: DescribeWorkshopProject
story: As a member, I want an agent to write a project's brief and requirements and move it through its stages as the work progresses, so that the project page says what we are building and how far along it is.

name: FinishWorkshopBuild
story: As a workspace runner, I want to attach verified artifacts and tests, so that members can inspect a revision without replacing newer work.

name: NameWorkshopProductRevision
story: As a member, I want to name the Wiki product revision a project builds, so that its concepts and evidence publish to the right release chain.

name: ProductRevisionChanges
story: As an authorized caller, I want to apply productrevision changes using explicit actions, so that each change has a durable receipt and explicit next steps.

key.description: Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.

name: ProjectChanges
story: As an authorized caller, I want to apply project changes using explicit actions, so that each change has a durable receipt and explicit next steps.

key.description: Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.
Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.
Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.

name: PublishWorkshopConcepts
story: As a member, I want to publish a project's concept mockups to the product revision in our Wiki, so that the release chain shows what the product will look like before anything is built.

name: RecordWorkshopUnit
story: As a member, I want to record each board or part I have in hand by its MAC address or serial, so that the assembly shows what is in stock and no unit is entered twice.
query:
mutation RecordWorkshopUnit($input: RecordWorkshopUnitInput!) {
  recordWorkshopUnit(input: $input) {
    id
    partNumber
    mpn
    mac
    serial
    status
    location
    projectId
    firmware
    notes
    revision
    createdBy
    updatedBy
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

name: RemoveWorkshopConcept
story: As a member, I want to remove a concept mockup that no longer shows what we mean to build, so that the gallery and the next publish carry only current design intent.

name: RequestWorkshopBuild
story: As a member, I want to request a workspace build from pinned source and parameters, so that agents can build a reproducible revision.

name: ResolvedWorkshopAssembly
story: As a prototype builder, I want to inspect the configured assembly and its source revisions, so that I can verify shared CAD and power across projects.

mcp.description: Read the expanded CAD, BOM and power assembly, buildPrice (knownSubtotal, estimatedSubtotal and unpricedUnits), and source revisions. Supply input.projectId and optional revision, configuration and numeric parameters. Use WorkshopAssembly for edits.

name: SaveWorkshopAssembly
story: As a member, I want an agent to lay out a device's product structure, its assemblies, parts, boards and firmware with the quantities and placements between them, so that the BOM, cost and 3D view show the design before anyone orders a part.

name: StartWorkshopDesign
story: As a member or an agent working for one, I want to start Workshop's design agent on a part or project request with one mutation, so that design work begins from wherever I am without opening the project page or waiting on the model.

mcp.description: Start Workshop's design agent on a part or project request (a new project, or a follow-up to one at the revision you saw) without waiting for the model. Answers the run id and status; follow it with WorkshopDesignRun.

name: SubmitWorkshopPcb
story: As a workspace agent, I want to publish a verified PCB package, so that members can review its board, quote and manufacturing files.

mcp.description: Import a KiCad PCB review package. Send projectId, observed revision, stable snapshotId, reviewPath and Workshop build manifest. PUT raw files to each returned URL with its headers, then repeat the same input to verify the bytes and read the PCB page path.

name: UnitChanges
story: As an authorized caller, I want to apply unit changes using explicit actions, so that each change has a durable receipt and explicit next steps.

key.description: Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.
Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.
Your stable key for this item: any short name, such as add-ada. Reuse it only to retry the same input.

name: UpdateWorkshopAssembly
story: As a prototype builder, I want my agent to save my assembly edit at the observed revision, so that concurrent project changes are preserved.

mcp.description: Save the full assembly returned by WorkshopAssembly with your edits and its observed revision. Reference another source with an empty assembly item reference {projectId, configuration?, parameters?, revision?}. Omit revision to follow source updates. On conflict, reread and reapply the intended edit.

name: UpdateWorkshopUnit
story: As a member, I want to mark a unit flashed, installed in a project or moved to a new bin at the revision I saw, so that the inventory follows each physical unit through the build.
query:
mutation UpdateWorkshopUnit($input: UpdateWorkshopUnitInput!) {
  updateWorkshopUnit(input: $input) {
    id
    partNumber
    mpn
    mac
    serial
    status
    location
    projectId
    firmware
    notes
    revision
    createdBy
    updatedBy
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

name: WorkshopAssembly
story: As a prototype builder, I want my agent to read the saved assembly and its power inputs, so that I can change one quantity and verify its effect.

mcp.description: Call graph_query with includeIdentifiers:true to read the complete saved assembly, including usage quantities, placements and power inputs, with its current project revision.

name: WorkshopDesignRun
story: As a member or an agent working for one, I want to read a design run I started, so that I know when the project revision it saved is ready and which project to open.

mcp.description: Read a design run started with StartWorkshopDesign: running, complete (with the projectId and revision it saved) or failed.

name: WorkshopProject
story: As a member or an agent working for one, I want to open one Workshop project by its slug with its requirements, notes, workspace builds with their tests and artifacts, and bench evidence, so that I can review or check the project from stored state instead of the page.

mcp.description: Read one project by slug: requirements, measurement and circuit notes, workspace builds (newest first) with their tests and artifacts, bench evidence, research and concepts. Read the model, BOM and build price with ResolvedWorkshopAssembly.

name: WorkshopProjectHandoff
story: As a Planning agent or member, I want to read back one Workshop project's persisted brief, requirements, stage and whole assembly, so that I can verify a hardware handoff from stored state instead of a summary.

name: WorkshopProjects
story: As a member or an agent working for one, I want to list the organization's Workshop projects with their slug, stage, brief and the product revision each builds, so that I can find the project to open without loading every model.

mcp.description: List Workshop projects with slug, stage, brief and the Wiki product revision each builds; open one with WorkshopProject by slug. With includeIdentifiers:true it gives the id and revision that ResolvedWorkshopAssembly, WorkshopAssembly and PCB imports take.

name: WorkshopUnits
story: As a member or an agent working for one, I want to list the physical units in stock by part number, MAC address, status or project with the firmware each last flashed, so that a build or test names the exact board it ran on.

mcp.description: List physical units, filtered by partNumber, mac, status or projectId, with location and the firmware last flashed.
